# General issue

## Summary

Provide a concise statement of the request or concern.

## Context

Share background, constraints, and relevant links.

## Requested outcome

Describe what decision, clarification, or change you need from maintainers.

## Suggested next step

Propose a practical next action (optional but helpful).

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues/discussions first.
- [ ] This topic does not fit the bug or feature template.
- [ ] I included enough context for maintainers to act.
